purpose: Dedicated isolation probes that pin down behavior the in-combo drivers could not observe reliably under parallel local-stack load. Each probe was a fresh browser context against the same local instance (base http://127.0.0.1:8916, real services).

probes.steps: fresh guest context, /genie/ workspace, real turn 'SAJ eSolar AIO3' (deepseek via WP proxy), click the card's primary 'Add to solution draft' action, then open /cart/

result.addControlTextAfterClick: Add to solution draft (label does not change — no in-card success label)
result.draftEndpointGet: 404 rest_no_route (the app defines no GET /genie/draft route; readback must use the native draft page)

probes.conclusion: The full Genie card → add → native Woo Solution draft chain works for a guest in EN; success is evidenced by the native draft row, not by a card label change.

probes.steps: same as probe4 with locale de-DE on /de/genie/, then /de/loesungsentwurf/
probes.conclusion: The chain works in DE too; vote/copy controls (3 __vote-class elements) do render on a settled card turn.

probes.steps: fresh guest, create project, fill site data (site use/country/annual 5000), Save project, inspect the 'Open roof workspace' control

result.plannerRequestFailures: all net::ERR_ABORTED (React Query dedup aborts; the engine answered 200 to every completed request)
result.roofButton: BUTTON.lp-button 'Open roof workspace' present in DOM with bounding box 0x0 (hidden parent DIV), before site data, after site data, and after save

probes.conclusion: Defect candidate: the roof workspace's only labeled entry control renders hidden on a fresh project and no visible alternative entry was found this pass. One earlier run (saturated parallel pass) did reach the roof workspace and rendered its explicit 'map unavailable → plan view' fallback, so the workspace itself loads; the reveal condition is unidentified.

result.workspaceShell: German (Neues Projekt, Projektarbeitsbereich, Projekt kann mit den bereits verfügbaren Angaben beginnen...)

probes.conclusion: Defect: the planner's create-form action strings are untranslated (English) in the DE locale on this build while the surrounding workspace is translated.

modelBudget: 3 real turns (2 product-card turns, 1 within earlier probes); all other probes are deterministic UI/engine behavior
